menu.summary_fr:
Que des jours verts : aucun robot de trading ne le donne. Vos dix règles gagnent environ un jour sur deux, et les réglages retenus n'y changent presque rien (50 à 52 jours verts sur 100). Forcer davantage de jours verts fait disparaître le gain.

Ce qu'on peut avoir : plus de semaines vertes. Sur 2018-2021, avec 1 000 € : 61 semaines vertes sur 100 sans rien changer, 70 à 77 avec trois réglages de mise.

Le prix :
- Gain annuel réduit d'un tiers à la moitié.
- Semaines vertes plus petites. Semaines rouges plus rares, mais aussi grosses qu'avant, parfois plus.
- Ce n'est pas un avantage nouveau : la même méthode sur des paris sans aucun avantage donne déjà 65 à 76 semaines vertes sur 100.

Les trois choix :
1. Fort : 77 sur 100, gain divisé par deux.
2. Doux : 77 sur 100, pire semaine une fois et demie plus grosse.
3. Coussin : 70 sur 100, mise jamais augmentée.

Chiffres tirés des années qui ont servi à construire les règles : le contrôle sur 2022-2025 décide ce qui est vraiment proposé.

profiles.plain: Each week starts at the normal stake. When the week is losing, only the five bitcoin / ether rules raise their stake (up to 3 times) to climb back; as soon as the week is winning, every rule bets small (a quarter of the normal stake, growing back as the week's gain grows) so the gain is not given back. The base stake is cut to 0.58 of the reference's so that the worst week stays the same.
profiles.frozen_rule: Code: /home/user/gold-orb/lab/r2/tracks/stake/stake.py, FROZEN['soft'] = {wk_cap 3, famcap (us100 1, gold 1, crypto 3), prot_k 4, prot_min 0.25}, base_scale 0.58. Clock: FP server time (New York + 7 h); week = Monday..Sunday; a result is booked at the trade's exit time. State w at a trade's entry = sum of (stake x R) of the trades closed STRICTLY before that entry inside the current server week, in units of the base stake. Stake multiplier m: if w < 0: crypto trades m = 1 + min(2, -w); us100 and gold trades m = 1. If w = 0: m = 1. If w > 0: m = min(1, max(0.25, w / 4)). Base stake = 0.58 x the reference's (0.58 % of the account if the reference is 1 %), so a trade risks between 0.145 % and 1.74 %. Entries, stops and exits of the ten rules untouched. Selected by the Addendum E rule among the configurations keeping >= 2/3 of the reference's total (gross, common period); 0.58 = smallest of the four scales (0.659 gross, 0.580 net).

profiles.name: A. Offshore funding carry, BTC+ETH 50/50, 5x on the short (reference only, not legally open to this user)
profiles.plain: Half the money buys bitcoin and ether. A small part goes as margin to sell the same quantity of the perpetual future, so price moves cancel out. Every 8 hours the shorts receive the funding payment. A robot rebalances both legs when the price has moved 8 %.
profiles.frozen_rule: Each coin gets 50 % of capital C. Hold q coins spot and short q USDT-M perp, with q = E/(S+F/5), so margin = notional/5. Funding is received on mark price at 00/08/16 UTC. Rebalance both legs to the same split of current equity at an hourly close when |F/F_last_rebal - 1| > 8 %. Liquidation is tested on the hourly mark-price high, at maintenance 0.5 %. If liquidated, the margin is lost, the spot is sold at the hour close and the position is reopened. Costs: spot 0.10 % per side, perp 0.05 % taker / 0.02 % maker, slippage 1-2 bp. Margin earns nothing. Always on, no funding filter.
profiles.period: Binance public funding and 1h spot/perp/mark klines, 2020-01-01 to 2026-11-10 (Nov 2026 funding from OKX). These are external public data, not the lab's in-sample or validation trades.
profiles.yearly_pct_on_account: Figures in USD on full capital (computed by my script lab/r2/tracks/carry/funding.py). Whole period: 9.9 %/yr gross, 8.9 %/yr net (offshore taker). By year, gross: 2023 6.8, 2024 11.0, 2025 4.3, 2026 2.2 (annualised). Net taker: 2025 3.6, 2026 1.7. 2021 was about 29-36 %. For comparison, the euro short-term rate (ECB) averaged 2.18 in 2025 and 2.10 in 2026, and was 2.44 on 2026-11-10.
profiles.avg_green_day_vs_red_day: Whole period: green day +0.040 % against red day -0.032 % (red/green 0.80). In 2025: +0.014 % (0.14 EUR on 1,000) against -0.008 %. In 2026: +0.013 % against -0.009 %, and only 70 % of days and 72 % of weeks are green.
profiles.worst_day_week_drawdown: Worst day -7.25 %, worst week -6.76 %, max drawdown -7.51 % (gross; net taker -7.8 / -7.4 / -8.2). All of it comes from one event: the short was liquidated during the rebound on 2020-03-13 (mark +23.7 % above that day's open; ETH twice at 5x). Without that day, the worst weeks are about -0.2 % (2022) and -0.1 % (2026).
profiles.zero_edge_control: Same rule with funding set to 0 (computed by my script): 50.2 % green days, 46.8 % green weeks, -0.57 %/yr gross and -2.6 %/yr with EU taker costs (27 % green weeks). Worst week -3.1 % (BTC) / -10 % (ETH, the March 2020 liquidation). The structure has no chance of losing half the account, except through a venue failure.
profiles.feasible_on_1000_eur: Mechanically yes: perp minimum about 100 USDT notional for BTC at Binance (from memory). Legally no: Binance global perps are not open to EEA/French retail (secondary source https://www.coinperps.com/learn/best-crypto-futures-platforms-in-europe). Offshore 5x for a French resident means an unlicensed venue.
profiles.where: Binance / Bybit / OKX global-style accounts. Not FP Markets, and not legally reachable from France at 5x.

profiles.name: B. EU-licensed funding carry, BTC+ETH 50/50, 2:1 on the short, EUR account hedged against the dollar
profiles.plain: The same trade at an EU-licensed venue, at 2:1 under the ESMA retail cap, so one third of the money sits idle as margin. The user's money is in euros and the position is worth dollars, so a long EURUSD 0.01 lot at FP Markets offsets the dollar. That hedge costs about 2 % a year.
profiles.frozen_rule: As profile A, but q = E/(S+F/2). Close-out follows the ESMA CFD rule (margin equity < 50 % of initial margin, i.e. < 25 % of notional, which is a rise of about +20 %); 50 % of the initial margin is returned. Costs at EU tier 0: spot 0.25 % maker / 0.40 % taker, perp 0.02 / 0.05 %, slippage 2-4 bp (from memory, Kraken-like). Rebalance band 8 %. The EUR result is the USD daily return minus 2.03 %/yr, which is FP's published EURUSD long swap of -6.23 USD per lot per night on 10 Nov 2026 (lab/results/r2/_paused_state.json). That cost is applied to all years.

profiles.name: A. Ten rules + one small S&P 500 trade a day, sized 12x (construction d)
profiles.plain: The robot keeps the ten validated rules but at a smaller stake, and adds one trade a day on the S&P 500 at 10:00 New York, in the direction of the first half hour, with a very close target and a far stop. proposal.honest_summary:
Honest answer: green days can be bought up to about 85 %, but in every construction the share obtained is the share the payoff shape gives with no edge at all, and the price is paid either in profit or in the size of red days. Green weeks, the user's first priority, do not follow: no construction here reaches the +8 points of Addendum E in sample with costs (best: +6.4 to +7.4 points).

- **What the validated rules can do alone:** exit shaping stops at 56 % of green days with costs (61 % without) and destroys the profit; the intraday martingale stops at 51 % (53 % without) and doubles the worst day. The rules place several trades a day, and the sum of several lopsided trades is again close to a coin flip.
- **The literal wish (profile B):** closing everything when the account is up one stake gives 65.6 % of green days with costs (67.9 % without), but leaves +22 %/yr against +202 %/yr (+49 against +247 without costs). At half a stake it is 75 % of green days and no profit left after costs.
- **The cheapest way found (profile A):** adding one high-hit daily S&P 500 trade sized 12x gives 68.5 % of green days and 64.9 % of green weeks with costs. At an equal worst week about half the profit remains, and a red day becomes 1.3 green days.

Profile A rests on a rule that is not established. Its net t-stat is 1.55 over nine years, it is the only survivor of 40 configurations, it turns negative when the direction is read at 60 minutes instead of 30, and it fails on the German index. If it has no edge, profile A keeps 66 % of green days and about 39 % of the profit; with no edge anywhere, the chance of losing half the account in four years is 41 %. Over 2013-2021 its maximum drawdown is 36.6 % against 28.6 % for the reference, so it fails Addendum E's drawdown test on the long period.

On 1,000 EUR, profile A cannot be run at its 0.40 % stake because of minimum lots. The workable form risks 12 % of the account on the daily trade, with a worst day of -16 % and a worst week of -28 % in the in-sample account simulation. Profile B is feasible as is; with real lots it gives 60 % of green days.
